name: SVR Poker Android
updateMessage: An optional SVR Poker Android update is available.
updateMenuPolicy: Hidden unless releaseReady is true, apkUrl is non-empty, and apkVersionCode is newer than the installed code.
notes: Phase 350 replaces the blank profile-avatar state with an immediate fallback preview, bounded 3D loading, visible status, and manual retry.
Camera 3 now owns a dedicated hemisphere, ambient, key, fill, rim, and gold lighting rig with ACES exposure and a deep-navy background.
Android physically removes every legacy controller root and external virtual stick while preserving exactly one Phase 347 MOVE/LOOK/action authority.
The Phase 350 integrity governor watches for late-created duplicate controls and removes them instead of merely hiding them.
Public-page navigation is audited by CI for missing local files, missing anchors, empty action targets, stale game links, and unsafe placeholder routes.
Phase 349 presence, seat ownership, reconnect recovery, and its truthful local-simulation fallback remain preserved.
Camera 3 remains free of player account, avatar, multiplayer presence, and Android controller modules.
No native Android wrapper source, signing identity, or installable APK is currently present in the repository.
Forced updates and recurring update prompts remain disabled.
